acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given strategies have been calculated (via useStrategies hook), when I view the Compare page, then I see a "Winner's Podium" component showing the top 3 strategies ranked by interest saved (highest savings = 1st place).
The podium displays for each position (1st, 2nd, 3rd): Strategy name, Interest saved vs baseline (ZAR formatted), Debt-free date (SA DD/MM/YYYY format).
Visual layout follows Olympic podium style: 1st place center/tallest, 2nd place left/medium, 3rd place right/shortest.
If the recommended strategy (from recommendation engine) is in 1st place, it displays a "Recommended" badge (teal Badge component from shadcn/ui).
Clicking a podium position scrolls the page to the detailed comparison table (smooth scroll behavior).

Podium uses the Balanced Teal theme: Cards use teal-600 (#0d9488) accent for 1st place, Gold/Silver/Bronze visual indicators (CSS colors: #FFD700, #C0C0C0, #CD7F32), Text follows semantic colors from UX spec.
If fewer than 3 valid strategies exist, the podium gracefully displays only the available strategies (2 or 1) without empty placeholders.
Component is responsive: Desktop (>1024px) horizontal podium layout, Mobile (<640px) vertical stacked layout.
Podium animates entrance with subtle fade-in using Tailwind CSS animate-in class.
Component shows skeleton loading state while isCalculating is true from calculation store.

constraints.constraint: Component follows Strategy Pattern - ADR-004. Pure presentation component, no business logic beyond sorting/filtering.
Use big.js for any monetary display. Convert Big to string for formatCurrency.
File naming: PascalCase for components (WinnersPodium.tsx), camelCase for hooks.
Path alias: Use @/ prefix for imports (e.g., @/hooks/useStrategies).
Primary color teal-600 (#0d9488). Never use color alone - pair with icons/labels for accessibility.
Touch targets minimum 44x44px on mobile. Larger form inputs minimum 48px height.
Charts/visuals must use patterns + colors for colorblind users.
Results from useStrategies().strategies are already sorted by interestSaved descending. Simply take first 3 items.
Use bestStrategy from hook as recommendedId initially until Story 5.5 recommendation engine.
Chart/UI rendering under 2 seconds (NFR-P3). Keep component lightweight.
